description: This file provides a helper function `resolveAuthEndpointUrl` that determines the full URL for API endpoints related to authentication. It selectively forces certain auth endpoints to use an external domain instead of the default base URL, based on pattern matching with regular expressions.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl(path, baseUrl)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a complete URL for a given API endpoint path, applying special rules for certain auth-related endpoints to redirect them to an external domain.
